subject: gk
question: Srimanta Sankar Dev is associated with which of these dance forms?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the eight classical dance forms of **India**.
 
• It originated in the northeastern state of **Assam**.
 
• This dance form was introduced by the great saint and reformer **Srimanta Sankar Dev** in the 15th century.
 
• Sattriya was initially performed in **Vaishnavite monasteries**, known as Sattras, as a form of devotional art to spread the teachings of Lord Krishna.
 
• The dance form combines **expressive gestures (abhinaya)**, a distinctive rhythm, and a unique style of storytelling to depict mythological narratives, primarily from the **Bhagavata Purana**.
 
• It is characterized by its **graceful movements**, intricate footwork, and expressions that portray devotion and spirituality.
 
• Sattriya dance has been recognized as one of the **Classical Dances of India by the Sangeet Natak Akademi** in 2000, highlighting its cultural and historical significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odissi**__

 __
 
• **Odissi** is one of the oldest surviving classical dance forms in India, originating from the state of **Odisha**.
 
• This dance form is primarily based on the **Natya Shastra** and revolves around themes of devotion to Lord **Jagannath**.
 
• It is known for its **fluid movements**, **tribhangi posture**, and intricate gestures.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**__
 __
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form that originates from **Manipur**, a northeastern state of India.
 
• It is deeply rooted in **Vaishnavism** and often portrays the **Ras Leela** of Radha and Krishna.
 
• This dance form is known for its **gentle and flowing movements** and lack of vigorous foot tapping.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**__
 
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in **North India**.
 
• It is known for its **intricate footwork**, **spins**, and expressive storytelling based on **mythological and historical tales**.
 
• The word "Kathak" is derived from "Katha," meaning **story**, emphasizing its storytelling roots.
